knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "DT", "here", "htmltools", "openxlsx", "plotly", "shiny"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the following packages before running the dashboard: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

ancestor_directories <- function(start_directory, maximum_levels = 10L) {
  current <- normalizePath(start_directory, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  output <- current
  for (index in seq_len(maximum_levels)) {
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    output <- c(output, parent)
    current <- parent
  }
  unique(output)
}

dashboard_input <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
dashboard_directory <- if (
  !is.null(dashboard_input) && length(dashboard_input) > 0L &&
    !is.na(dashboard_input[[1]]) && nzchar(dashboard_input[[1]])
) {
  dirname(normalizePath(dashboard_input[[1]], winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
} else {
  getwd()
}

configured_processing_script <- Sys.getenv(
  "THEOGRAPH_PROCESSING_SCRIPT", unset = ""
)
search_roots <- unique(c(
  ancestor_directories(dashboard_directory),
  ancestor_directories(getwd()),
  here::here()
))
processing_directories <- unique(c(
  file.path(search_roots, "data_processing", "r_scripts"),
  dashboard_directory
))
exact_processing_candidates <- file.path(
  processing_directories, "Data_Extraction_Processing.R"
)
versioned_processing_candidates <- unlist(lapply(
  processing_directories,
  list.files,
  pattern = "^Data_Extraction_Processing(\\([0-9]+\\))?\\.R$",
  full.names = TRUE
), use.names = FALSE)
processing_candidates <- unique(c(
  configured_processing_script,
  exact_processing_candidates,
  versioned_processing_candidates
))
processing_candidates <- processing_candidates[nzchar(processing_candidates)]
processing_script <- processing_candidates[file.exists(processing_candidates)][1]

if (length(processing_script) == 0L || is.na(processing_script)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Could not find Data_Extraction_Processing.R. Searched:\n- ",
      paste(processing_candidates, collapse = "\n- "),
      "\nSet THEOGRAPH_PROCESSING_SCRIPT to its full path if it is stored elsewhere."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
processing_script <- normalizePath(
  processing_script, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE
)
source(processing_script, local = FALSE)

theograph <- Theograph_Data
patient_choices <- stats::setNames(
  theograph$patient_profile$Patient_ID,
  theograph$patient_profile$Patient_Name
)

```{r app, echo=FALSE}
nhs_blue <- "#005EB8"
nhs_dark_blue <- "#003087"
event_colours <- c(
  "Condition" = "#DA291C",
  "Biomarker" = "#005EB8",
  "Medicine" = "#ED8B00",
  "Risk Score" = "#AE2573"
)
trace_colours <- c(
  "#005EB8", "#41A7A4", "#7C2855", "#ED8B00", "#330072", "#007F3B"
)

format_date <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "Unknown", format(as.Date(x), "%d %B %Y"))
}

format_value <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE))
}

patient_age <- function(date_of_birth, on_date = Sys.Date()) {
  if (length(date_of_birth) == 0L || is.na(date_of_birth)) return(NA_integer_)
  birthday_this_year <- as.Date(sprintf(
    "%s-%s", format(on_date, "%Y"), format(date_of_birth, "%m-%d")
  ))
  as.integer(format(on_date, "%Y")) - as.integer(format(date_of_birth, "%Y")) -
    as.integer(on_date < birthday_this_year)
}

make_hover_text <- function(data) {
  value_text <- ifelse(
    is.na(data$Value),
    "",
    paste0("<br><b>Value:</b> ", format_value(data$Value), " ", data$Units)
  )
  paste0(
    "<b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(data$Event_Name), "</b>",
    "<br><b>Date:</b> ", format(as.Date(data$Event_Date), "%d %B %Y"),
    value_text,
    "<br><b>Condition:</b> ", htmltools::htmlEscape(data$Linked_Condition),
    "<br><b>Detail:</b> ", htmltools::htmlEscape(data$Event_Detail)
  )
}

series_display_label <- function(series_data) {
  series_name <- series_data$Display_Series[[1]]
  unit_values <- unique(stats::na.omit(series_data$Units))

  if (length(unit_values) == 1L) {
    paste0("<b>", series_name, "</b><br>", unit_values[[1]])
  } else {
    paste0("<b>", series_name, "</b>")
  }
}

medicine_stop_recorded <- function(event_row) {
  if (nrow(event_row) == 0L) return(FALSE)

  zero_dose <- !is.na(event_row$Value[[1]]) && event_row$Value[[1]] == 0
  detail <- tolower(event_row$Event_Detail[[1]] %||% "")
  stop_language <- grepl(
    paste0(
      "\\b(stop|stopp?ed|stopping|discontinu(ed|ing|ation)?|ceased?|",
      "withdrawn|taken off)\\b"
    ),
    detail,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  zero_dose || stop_language
}

extend_medicine_trace <- function(trace_data, all_trace_events, today = Sys.Date()) {
  if (nrow(trace_data) == 0L || nrow(all_trace_events) == 0L) return(trace_data)

  all_trace_events <- all_trace_events |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Event_Date)
  latest_record <- all_trace_events[nrow(all_trace_events), , drop = FALSE]
  is_stopped <- medicine_stop_recorded(latest_record)
  endpoint_date <- if (is_stopped) latest_record$Event_Date[[1]] else today

  eligible_doses <- trace_data |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$Event_Date <= endpoint_date) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Event_Date)
  if (nrow(eligible_doses) == 0L) return(trace_data)

  last_dose <- eligible_doses[nrow(eligible_doses), , drop = FALSE]
  if (endpoint_date <= last_dose$Event_Date[[1]]) return(trace_data)

  endpoint <- last_dose
  endpoint$Event_Date <- as.Date(endpoint_date)
  endpoint$Event_Detail <- if (is_stopped) {
    "Medicine carried to the recorded stop date for display."
  } else {
    "Active medicine: last recorded dose carried forward to today for display."
  }
  endpoint$Hover_Text <- make_hover_text(endpoint)
  endpoint$Is_Display_Endpoint <- TRUE

  dplyr::bind_rows(trace_data, endpoint) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Event_Date)
}

create_series_plot <- function(series_data, range_start, range_end) {
  series_data <- series_data |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Event_Date, .data$Event_Name)
  series_data$Hover_Text <- make_hover_text(series_data)
  series_data$Is_Display_Endpoint <- FALSE

  series_name <- series_data$Display_Series[[1]]
  event_type <- series_data$Event_Type[[1]]
  base_colour <- unname(event_colours[[event_type]])
  if (is.null(base_colour) || is.na(base_colour)) base_colour <- nhs_blue

  plot <- plotly::plot_ly()
  numeric_events <- !all(is.na(series_data$Value))

  if (identical(event_type, "Condition") || !numeric_events) {
    plot <- plotly::add_trace(
      plot,
      data = series_data,
      x = ~Event_Date,
      y = rep(1, nrow(series_data)),
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = base_colour, width = 2, dash = "dot"),
      marker = list(color = base_colour, size = 10, symbol = "diamond"),
      text = ~Hover_Text,
      hoverinfo = "text",
      showlegend = FALSE,
      name = series_name
    )
    plot <- plotly::layout(
      plot,
      yaxis = list(
        title = list(text = ""),
        showticklabels = FALSE,
        zeroline = FALSE,
        range = c(0.75, 1.25)
      )
    )
  } else {
    event_names <- unique(series_data$Event_Name)
    show_legend <- length(event_names) > 1L

    for (index in seq_along(event_names)) {
      event_name <- event_names[[index]]
      all_trace_events <- series_data |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_Name == event_name)
      trace_data <- series_data |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Event_Name == event_name, !is.na(.data$Value))
      if (nrow(trace_data) == 0L) next

      if (identical(event_type, "Medicine")) {
        trace_data <- extend_medicine_trace(trace_data, all_trace_events)
      }

      trace_colour <- if (length(event_names) == 1L) {
        base_colour
      } else {
        trace_colours[((index - 1L) %% length(trace_colours)) + 1L]
      }
      line_shape <- if (identical(event_type, "Medicine")) "hv" else "linear"

      plot <- plotly::add_trace(
        plot,
        data = trace_data,
        x = ~Event_Date,
        y = ~Value,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = trace_colour, width = 2.5, shape = line_shape),
        marker = list(
          color = trace_colour,
          size = ifelse(trace_data$Is_Display_Endpoint, 0, 8)
        ),
        text = ~Hover_Text,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        showlegend = show_legend,
        legendgroup = paste(series_name, event_name, sep = "-"),
        name = event_name
      )
    }

    plot <- plotly::layout(
      plot,
      yaxis = list(
        title = list(text = ""),
        fixedrange = FALSE,
        zeroline = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  plotly::layout(
    plot,
    xaxis = list(
      range = c(range_start, range_end),
      tickformat = "%b %Y",
      tickangle = 0,
      automargin = TRUE,
      fixedrange = FALSE
    ),
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
    hovermode = "closest",
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF",
    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFFFF"
  )
}

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  selected_profile <- shiny::reactive({
    shiny::req(input$patient_id)
    theograph$patient_profile |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == input$patient_id)
  })

  patient_series <- shiny::reactive({
    shiny::req(input$patient_id)
    theograph$series_catalogue |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == input$patient_id) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$Display_Order, .data$Display_Series)
  })

  all_series_values <- shiny::reactive(patient_series()$Display_Series)

  shiny::observeEvent(input$patient_id, {
    choices <- all_series_values()
    shiny::updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "series_filter",
      choices = choices,
      selected = choices,
      server = TRUE
    )
  }, ignoreInit = FALSE)

  shiny::observeEvent(input$select_all_series, {
    choices <- all_series_values()
    shiny::updateSelectizeInput(
      session, "series_filter", choices = choices, selected = choices,
      server = TRUE
    )
  })

  shiny::observeEvent(input$clear_all_series, {
    shiny::updateSelectizeInput(
      session, "series_filter", choices = all_series_values(), selected = character(),
      server = TRUE
    )
  })

  selected_timeline_events <- shiny::reactive({
    shiny::req(input$patient_id)
    selected_series <- input$series_filter

    if (is.null(selected_series) || length(selected_series) == 0L) {
      return(theograph$timeline_events[0, , drop = FALSE])
    }

    theograph$timeline_events |>
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Patient_ID == input$patient_id,
        .data$Display_Series %in% selected_series
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$Display_Order, .data$Event_Date, .data$Event_Name
      )
  })

  selected_notes <- shiny::reactive({
    shiny::req(input$patient_id)
    theograph$clinical_notes |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == input$patient_id) |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$Note_Date))
  })

  output$profile_focus <- shiny::renderUI({
    profile <- selected_profile()
    shiny::tags$p(
      shiny::tags$strong("Journey focus: "),
      profile$Profile_Focus[[1]]
    )
  })

  output$patient_profile <- shiny::renderUI({
    profile <- selected_profile()
    age <- patient_age(profile$Patient_DOB[[1]])
    shiny::tagList(
      shiny::tags$p(
        shiny::tags$strong(profile$Patient_Name[[1]]), shiny::tags$br(),
        "ID: ", profile$Patient_ID[[1]], shiny::tags$br(),
        "Date of birth: ", format_date(profile$Patient_DOB[[1]]), shiny::tags$br(),
        "Age: ", ifelse(is.na(age), "Unknown", paste(age, "years")), shiny::tags$br(),
        "Gender: ", profile$Patient_Gender[[1]], shiny::tags$br(),
        "Weight: ", profile$Weight_kg[[1]], " kg", shiny::tags$br(),
        "BMI: ", profile$BMI[[1]]
      )
    )
  })

  output$qrisk2_summary <- shiny::renderUI({
    risk <- theograph$qrisk2_events |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == input$patient_id) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$Event_Date)

    if (nrow(risk) == 0L) {
      return(shiny::tags$p("No QRisk2 event is available."))
    }

    baseline <- risk[1, , drop = FALSE]
    latest <- risk[nrow(risk), , drop = FALSE]
    shiny::tagList(
      shiny::tags$div(class = "metric", paste0(latest$Value[[1]], "%")),
      shiny::tags$div(
        class = "metric-label",
        "Latest synthetic score ", format_date(latest$Event_Date[[1]])
      ),
      shiny::tags$hr(),
      shiny::tags$p(
        shiny::tags$strong("Baseline: "), baseline$Value[[1]], "% on ",
        format_date(baseline$Event_Date[[1]])
      )
    )
  })

  output$timeline_count <- shiny::renderUI({
    data <- selected_timeline_events()
    panel_count <- dplyr::n_distinct(data$Display_Series)
    shiny::tags$span(
      class = "timeline-count",
      paste(panel_count, "visualisations •", nrow(data), "event points")
    )
  })

  timeline_height <- shiny::reactive({
    panel_count <- dplyr::n_distinct(selected_timeline_events()$Display_Series)
    max(300L, 105L * panel_count + 55L)
  })

  output$timeline_plot_ui <- shiny::renderUI({
    plotly::plotlyOutput(
      "timeline_plot",
      height = paste0(timeline_height(), "px"),
      width = "100%"
    )
  })

  output$timeline_plot <- plotly::renderPlotly({
    data <- selected_timeline_events()
    shiny::validate(
      shiny::need(nrow(data) > 0L, "Select at least one timeline series.")
    )

    selected_order <- patient_series() |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$Display_Series %in% unique(data$Display_Series))
    series_names <- selected_order$Display_Series

    range_start <- min(data$Event_Date, na.rm = TRUE) - 45
    range_end <- max(c(data$Event_Date, Sys.Date()), na.rm = TRUE) + 45

    plots <- lapply(series_names, function(series_name) {
      series_data <- data |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Display_Series == series_name)
      create_series_plot(series_data, range_start, range_end)
    })

    panel_count <- length(series_names)
    panel_annotations <- lapply(seq_along(series_names), function(index) {
      series_data <- data |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$Display_Series == series_names[[index]])

      list(
        x = 0,
        y = 1 - ((index - 0.5) / panel_count),
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        text = series_display_label(series_data),
        textangle = 0,
        showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "right",
        yanchor = "middle",
        xshift = -60,
        align = "right",
        font = list(size = 12, color = "#212B32")
      )
    })

    combined <- if (length(plots) == 1L) {
      plots[[1]]
    } else {
      plotly::subplot(
        plots,
        nrows = length(plots),
        shareX = TRUE,
        titleY = TRUE,
        margin = 0
      )
    }

    plotly::layout(
      combined,
      height = timeline_height(),
      autosize = TRUE,
      hovermode = "closest",
      annotations = panel_annotations,
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.02),
      margin = list(l = 265, r = 20, t = 20, b = 55)
    ) |>
      plotly::config(
        displaylogo = FALSE,
        responsive = TRUE,
        modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d")
      )
  })

  output$event_table <- DT::renderDT({
    data <- selected_timeline_events() |>
      dplyr::select(
        .data$Event_Date, .data$Event_Type, .data$Event_Name,
        .data$Linked_Condition, .data$Display_Series, .data$Value,
        .data$Units, .data$Event_Detail
      )

    DT::datatable(
      data,
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top",
      options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
    ) |>
      DT::formatDate("Event_Date", method = "toLocaleDateString")
  })

  output$note_year_filter <- shiny::renderUI({
    notes <- selected_notes()
    years <- sort(unique(format(notes$Note_Date, "%Y")), decreasing = TRUE)
    shiny::selectInput(
      "note_year", "Year", choices = c("All years" = "", years), selected = ""
    )
  })

  filtered_notes <- shiny::reactive({
    notes <- selected_notes()
    query <- trimws(input$notes_search %||% "")
    selected_year <- input$note_year %||% ""

    if (nzchar(query)) {
      notes <- notes |>
        dplyr::filter(grepl(tolower(query), tolower(.data$Note_Text), fixed = TRUE))
    }
    if (nzchar(selected_year)) {
      notes <- notes |>
        dplyr::filter(format(.data$Note_Date, "%Y") == selected_year)
    }
    notes
  })

  output$clinical_notes_table <- DT::renderDT({
    notes <- filtered_notes() |>
      dplyr::select(.data$Note_Date, .data$Note_Type, .data$Note_Text)
    DT::datatable(
      notes,
      rownames = FALSE,
      escape = TRUE,
      options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE)
    ) |>
      DT::formatDate("Note_Date", method = "toLocaleDateString")
  })

  output$dictionary_table <- DT::renderDT({
    DT::datatable(
      theograph$data_dictionary,
      rownames = FALSE,
      filter = "top",
      options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE)
    )
  })

  output$download_patient_data <- shiny::downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      paste0("Theograph_", input$patient_id, "_", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      patient_id <- input$patient_id
      download_data <- list(
        `Patient Profile` = theograph$patient_profile |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == patient_id),
        Events = theograph$events |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == patient_id),
        `Clinical Notes` = theograph$clinical_notes |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$Patient_ID == patient_id),
        `Data Dictionary` = theograph$data_dictionary
      )
      openxlsx::write.xlsx(download_data, file, overwrite = TRUE)
    }
  )
}

shiny::shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server, options = list(height = 2200))
```
